newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones dropped 60.48 points to 6,878.89. PLDT's ADR dipped $0 1 3/8 to $59 1/4.
* The peso closed lower 26.323 from 26.322 to the dollar.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index fell 9.40 points to 3,261.24.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.28125 percent.
